title: Unable to mock Dependency in unit test
body:
### First Check

- [X] I added a very descriptive title here.
- [X] I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it.
- [X] I searched the FastAPI documentation, with the integrated search.
- [X] I already searched in Google "How to X in FastAPI" and didn't find any information.
- [X] I already read and followed all the tutorial in the docs and didn't find an answer.
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Pydantic](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Swagger UI](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [ReDoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc).

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
async def get_final_result(
        func1=Depends(get_func1),
        func2=Depends(get_func2)
):
    """
    Returns the response.
    """
    val = func1["outputs"][0]["value"]
    return Model(
         val = val
    )

@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
def sample_fastapi_client():
    """Get a FastAPI test client for the actual app"""
    yield TestClient(SampleAppBuilder.get_app())

async def mock_func1_function():
    return {
        "id": "",
        "outputs": [
             "name": "output",
             "value": "I am mocked"
        ],
    }
async def test_sample_class(sample_fastapi_client):
    sample_fastapi_client.dependency_overrides[get_func1] = mock_func1_function
    sample_fastapi_client.dependency_overrides[get_func2] = mock_func2_function
    response = sample_fastapi_client.get("/endpoint")
    assert response.status_Code == 200
```


### Description

func1 makes a call to an external httpx client and returns a json response. The output of func1 is respose.json() and similarly for func2. When I try to override those dependencies I would expect that instead of making downstream calls I am able to call my mocked function but it is not happening as expected and even if I assert response.status_code==200 or 400 my test case never gets executed.

I am very new to fastapi and I try to read the official docs as much as I can. I am tryign to set up a fast api app using the template so it comes with the conftest.py, models, routers sections.

### Operating System

macOS

### Operating System Details

_No response_

### FastAPI Version

0.115.8

### Pydantic Version

2.10.6

### Python Version

3.11.5

### Additional Context

I have read similar github articles and other online forum discussions and tried some of the solutions but I think I cannot make this one work or I keep missing some important detail here
